svg.title: Proof. Test unit vectors and apply the one-variable estimate φ′(0) = [φ(s) −φ(0)]/s − R s 0 (1 − σ/s)φ′′(σ) dσ to φ = Dih along a line. For the consequence induct on the order: at order zero take B = b; for the step i →i + 1 choose c = a + max(0, d −b) + 1 and b′ = b −1 −c and use the order-i assertion with target b′ and ball exponent c. Eventually 2y−c ≤y−a, so the smaller balls around points within y−c of the centre lie in the original ball, and (PL4) gives 2yb′+c + yd−c, both exponents strictly below b.
